bias: 'An unmitigated disaster. Well, that escalated quickly.' Wednesday's vol-crush rally gave way to a bloodbath: NQ lost 28444-28485 premarket, delivered a textbook gap-down-and-go, annihilated level after level and exceeded the July low — the target of the multi-month LAAF he's discussed for weeks; ES tagged its July RTH low 7346 to the tick after hours; YM fell 2,500+ from its OR high. Both have reached major HTF downside objectives (NQ exceeded the lowest weekly levels — new ones added). The move is extraordinarily stretched (ES nearly 2× the weekly straddle, NQ beyond it): that doesn't mean a bottom, nor does it negate the damage, but it substantially raises the risk of violent inventory corrections. 'The challenge now isn't recognizing that the market is bearish. It's avoiding the temptation to chase an already historic liquidation while remaining alert for further downside.'
wildcard: No long is particularly safe: ES until it reclaims at least 7580.5 (top of Thursday's B-period singles 7539-7580.5); NQ's first structural improvement is a reclaim of its singles 27358-27457. 'A market can be extremely oversold and still offer absolutely terrible long opportunities.' Trading lower first and failing offers a better foundation for a real rally than bouncing out of the gate (sequence matters more on ES than NQ). ES can rally 100+ handles just to reach the first spot savvy sellers step in — longs liquidating are not savvy sellers. He's not initiating intraday shorts down here either; remaining puts managed on the new weekly levels, may add TQQQ for a countertrend if sellers show exhaustion. Confluence below: ES 200-day / YTD VWAP / Jan-high AVWAP ~7305-7354; NQ approaching the late-2025/early-2026 double-top back-test ≈ 61.8% retrace. New weekly levels: ES 7313-7317, 7292-7296, 7269-7275, 7236-7240, 7208-7214, 7169-7182*; NQ 26840, 26787-26812, 26600-26630, 26500-26523, 26390-26408*, 26258-26291*, 26072-26102*. No daily levels.

brief.happened: Opened 7707.5 (RTH high 7712.5 at the open), B-period single prints 7539-7580.5, 7497-7504 / 7483-7486 gave way, 12:00 pullback high 7472.25, ARH 7457.75 at 14:xx just under 7459-7462, low 7388 at 14:05 then a downward spike into the close — spike base 7388, RTH low 7377.25; after hours bled to 7346, the July RTH low to the tick, closing AH at 7353.
brief.pivot: Mark 7388 (spike base) and 7377.25 (RTH low). Acceptance below the closing spike = continuation → 7346 → 7326 (July ETH) → 7232.25 (July low = the trap-door completion, then monitor for a durable low). Reclaim of 7388 → 7393-7399 → 7412-7417 could trigger a rally toward the ARH.
brief.higher: LAAF of the 7457.75 ARH = classic continuation short after a trend day down. 7483-7486 (incl. LAAF) is particularly attractive for sellers — ~38.2% retrace of Thursday's RTH high → AH low, a key intraday LVN, supply overhead. Short-covering rallies can travel much further than expected — let them exhaust rather than fade prematurely, but don't become a late bull. Even a LAAF of the 7514-7517 lower high meets more supply, still nowhere near the singles; 7541-7543 sits at the bottom of the singles. 'ES can rally massively from here and still be a short.'
brief.lower: Acceptance below 7388 / 7377.25 → 7346 → 7326 → 7232.25. Initiating fresh shorts into extended lows is poor form, yet that doesn't make longs safe. The 200-day / YTD VWAP / Jan-high AVWAP cluster ~7305-7354 could produce a meaningful response (NQ's did initially then rolled over) — an initial responsive bid is not a durable low; wait for evidence sellers are losing control.

brief.happened: Lost 28444-28485 premarket; gap-down-and-go from 28203, B-period singles 27358-27457, through the July lows (27317.5 RTH / 27201.5 ETH) to 26732 at 10:50, inventory bounces to 27358 (11:xx) and 27180 (14:50), downward spike into the close — spike base 26732, RTH low 26718 ('a spike for ants'). Beyond the lowest original weekly levels; approaching the back-test of the late-2025 / early-2026 double top ≈ the 61.8% retrace of the YTD-low → ATH advance.
brief.pivot: A terrible location to initiate fresh shorts — not that a low is in. Reclaim of 26840 and 26855-26911 (a substantial buyer sat in the 26800s — did he liquidate into the spike?) could trigger a short-covering rally; shorts then on a failed reclaim of 27201.5 (July ETH low) or 27313-27339 (July RTH low 27317.5), and especially at the 27358-27457 singles.
brief.higher: Less concerned about NQ trading higher first than ES given the proximity of major HTF references and the extent of the liquidation. The objective is to let the extended market correct inventory and evaluate whether sellers regain control at better locations — the singles 27358-27457 are the key spot; reclaiming them is the first major sign of structural improvement.
brief.lower: Break and continuation below 26718 is objectively a continuation short, but he has no intention of initiating down here; the new weekly levels (26840, 26787-26812, 26600-26630, 26500-26523, 26390-26408*, 26258-26291*, 26072-26102*) are for managing remaining puts. A partial back-test of the double top is anywhere in this region, a complete one just below. Constructive action there (sellers failing to generate downside with every opportunity) → he may keep a few XSP puts and add TQQQ for a countertrend rally.
